shortDescription: Your unofficial tactical guide to Sziget 2026. Offline maps, AI scout & more.
longDescription:
Dominate the Island of Freedom with Sziget Insider 2026.

Built for elite festival-goers who need zero-latency access to the lineup and map, even when the network is crushed. Sziget Insider is the only companion app that prioritizes high-density performance and tactical utility.

FEATURES:
- AI Scout: Personalized recommendations using Genkit and Gemini 1.5 Flash.
- Tactical Map: Coordinate-mapped stages, water points, and hidden bars.
- Spotify DNA: Match the lineup against your top tracks.
- Survival Toolkit: Currency converter, SOS beacon, and Hungarian phrases.
- Offline-First: Works at 0.0kbps. No signal required for core tools.

Join the 2026 edition with elite intelligence.
